title: Detailed scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='3' fill='#1a2a4a'/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='11' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='10' fill='#444444'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='6' fill='#5a5a5a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='3' fill='#888888'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#cc3333'/>
  <!-- rear tire tread -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='9.5' fill='none' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='11' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='10' fill='#444444'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='6' fill='#5a5a5a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='3' fill='#888888'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#cc3333'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='9.5' fill='none' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M14 70 Q26 58 38 70' fill='none' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- front fender -->
  <path d='M62 70 Q74 58 86 70' fill='none' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- deck / floorboard -->
  <rect x='28' y='68' width='34' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d4d4d4'/>
  <rect x='30' y='69' width='30' height='2' fill='#bbbbbb'/>

  <!-- body / frame connecting deck to rear -->
  <path d='M26 68 L26 58 Q26 52 32 52 L48 52 L48 68 Z' fill='#dd2222'/>
  <path d='M48 52 L60 52 L60 68 L48 68 Z' fill='#cc1111'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <path d='M28 56 L46 56 L46 58 L28 58 Z' fill='#ff5555' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M30 52 L52 52 Q54 52 54 50 L54 48 Q54 46 52 46 L32 46 Q30 46 30 48 Z' fill='#333366'/>
  <path d='M31 47 L51 47 L51 49 L31 49 Z' fill='#444488'/>

  <!-- steering column -->
  <path d='M58 52 L66 30' fill='none' stroke='#cc1111' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 52 L66 30' fill='none' stroke='#ff3333' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- handlebar stem -->
  <path d='M64 32 L68 26' fill='none' stroke='#999999' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- handlebars -->
  <path d='M56 28 Q62 24 68 26 Q74 24 78 28' fill='none' stroke='#bbbbbb' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <path d='M55 29 Q57 27 59 28' fill='none' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M77 29 Q79 27 81 28' fill='none' stroke='#333333' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='34' r='4' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <!-- headlight mount -->
  <rect x='69' y='37' width='6' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aaaaaa'/>

  <!-- front fork -->
  <line x1='70' y1='38' x2='74' y2='68' stroke='#999999' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='38' x2='74' y2='68' stroke='#777777' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <path d='M60 72 L70 72 Q74 72 74 70' fill='none' stroke='#bbbbbb' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#aaaaaa'/>

  <!-- kickstand -->
  <line x1='40' y1='70' x2='36' y2='84' stroke='#777777' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- decorative stripe on body -->
  <path d='M28 62 L46 62' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 L58 62' stroke='#ffaa22' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
